business_summary: Sinfonia Technology Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells semiconductors, aerospace, automobile, mobility, and industrial electrical equipment in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers clean transport systems, including 300mm FOUP load port, 300/200MM auto switch load port, 200MM SMIF load port, EFEM, panel FOUP load port, and tape frame FOUP load port; testing systems, such as high-speed dynamometer and power train testers; vibrating equipment, including vibrating conveyor, vibrating drier and cooler, and small vibrating equipment; parts feeders, such as dual-motion parts feeder, high speed parts feeder, and vibrating transporting table; and lifting magnets. It also provides electrical equipment and central monitoring system for waterworks and sewage work, and plant factory system using only artificial light; electrical components for aircraft, thrust vector control electrical actuator system, and electrical components for space station; automotive electrical components; transportation and power control systems, such as speed generators and controllers for industrial vehicles; printer systems, such as color stream S3, color stream CE1, and CHC-C300; and clutches and brakes, including holding brake for industrial robots and ultra-compact electromagnetic brakes. In addition, it offers automated cell culture system and intelligent cell processing system; and one-board controller, analog input board, and sensor node relay. The company was formerly known as Shinko Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sinfonia Technology Co.,Ltd. in April 2009. Sinfonia Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
